title: JOYOR S5-Z All-terrain Electric Scooter
sellingPoints: With turn signal function, safer travel

details.title: Ultimate All-TerrainPerformance
details.content: Speed, efficiency, and adrenaline, all in one with the Joyor S5-Z.This electric scooter will elevate your urban mobility experience to a new level.

details.title: Advanced control
details.content: Control your Joyor S5-Z ride with the multifunctional LCD screen. Access settings and enhance your riding experience with driving modes and added flexibility.

details.title: Powerful Motor
details.content: With a 600W Motor Power, the Electric Scooter Joyor S5-Z Takes you to New Heights,Tackling Terrains with up to a 20°Incline.

details.title: Limitless Exploration Awaits
details.content: Embark on limitless journeys with the Joyor S5-Z's 48V 13Ah rechargeable lithium battery, providing an expansive range of 55 km. Whether for daily commuting or leisurely rides, this electric scooter invites you to discover boundless exploration possibilities.

details.title: Double Front and Rear Suspension
details.content: Experience ultimate riding comfort and control with dual swingarm suspension system on front and rear wheels.

details.title: Foldable and portable
details.content: Discover the captivating design of the Joyor S5-Z featuring an aluminum alloy frame and eye-catching orange swingarm, promising stability and versatility on all terrains.

moreDetails.caption: New turn signals enhance safety by increasing visibility during maneuvers while riding.
Stay safe and visible with Joyor's front and rear lights, perfect for low-light conditions.
Enjoy precise braking with front and rear disc brakes for consistent safety and peace of mind on your Joyor S5 ride.
Take your ride to the next level with high-performance 10"x3" off-road pneumatic tyres.
